prediction_ilnd7_equals_the_throwaway.verdict: CONFIRMED on all five tiers. No CI-solid deviation anywhere, so there is no finding to report ahead of the rest.
prediction_ilnd7_equals_the_throwaway.reading: deltas run +0.0000 to +0.0033 with every replicate z at or below 0.2. The committed implementation is fractionally BETTER on the mix (+0.0033), which is consistent with the capacity clamp and the set-guard tightening rather than with any behavioural difference.

ground_truth_counters.verdict: the mix rate falls 9.6% -> 8.4% and lands on the SHIFT-ONLY floor of 8.3%. That floor is the right target, not zero: bounds written straight from a named failure are misattributed whenever the naming is, and the fix does not touch that path. What the fix removed is the quarantine-mediated excess above the floor, 1.3 points of it, leaving 0.1.

suppression_rules_on_the_mix.reading: on the mix, suspects struck off the list fall 1,100 -> 526 and suspicions cleared fall 133 -> 50. The false exculpatory evidence is no longer accepted, which is the mechanism stated as a counter.

cost_side.reading: promotions on the unknown-0.3 tier rise 11 -> 55, because suspicion that honest probes used to clear now survives to conviction. That is the visible cost of the fix and it matches the small score give-back on the unknown-only tiers.

ground_truth_counters.instrumentation_gap: the suspects_recorded counter reads 0 in the committed build. The hook did not apply: 56c76b05f wrapped the RecordSuspectFailure call in a DisableQuarantine check and reindented it, so the patch string missed. Promotions and the two suppression counters did apply and are non-zero, so the quarantine is demonstrably running; the zero is an artifact of the throwaway patch and NOT a finding.

committed_v3.verdict: The committed fix reproduces the measured one. deg_hard_mix goes 0.4698 on the branch tip to 0.5138 committed, which is +0.0439 against the tip and +0.0098 against the round-2 reference the loss was measured from, so the 0.034 is fully recovered and slightly exceeded. The clean tier is unchanged to four decimals. The unknown-only give-back is -0.0025 at unknown 0.2 and -0.0006 at unknown 0.3, both smaller than the throwaway's and neither significant. The exp-030 record can close.
